changes.comment: adaptMcpTools escapes control characters (C0, DEL, C1, U+2028/U+2029) as \uXXXX in its skip warning, so a server-supplied tool name or schema cannot break or forge a log line; the structured skipped record is unchanged. CAPABILITIES.md: the JsonSchema.fromJson subset an MCP tool schema must fit now includes nullable anyOf/oneOf, local $ref and schema-valued additionalProperties.
